about_the_game:
Malandanti is a roguelike action-RPG set in a dying world, where covens of powerful witches vie for power as everything around them is slowly consumed by the enigmatic Blight.

How many souls can you collect to fuel your cauldron?

On the battered continent of Ique, the only true currency is souls. Venture out into the wilderness, fight monsters, craft spells, brew potions and utilize almost infinite combos from six schools of magic to build your coven!

Collect your Sisters, slay the avatar of the Blight and claim it's soul so you may found the greatest coven to ever exist!

  • Fight your way through dungeons, swamps and ruins infested by pirate gangs, cults, demons, undead, arcane entities and other horrors; and harvest their souls to increase your power.

  • Discover recipes for powerful spells, potions and runes to craft.

  • Semi-procedural itemization will give you unending tools and combinations to accomplish your goal, but beware: you will face greater and more powerful enemies along the way!

  • Use your powers of divination to gather information on dungeons before you enter, and outfit your witch with great care so she may have a chance at survival.

  • Find your lost sisters and save them from the clutches of the enemy so they can join your cause!

  • Use over 300 unique, craftable spells and elevate your coven over all others.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains cartoon like depiction of blood, gore and violent deaths.
